about.title: About Athar
about.subtitle: Palestinian Heritage & Modern Design
about.heritageDescription: Athar is a brand inspired by the spirit of Palestine, blending copper, known for its positive symbolism, with Palestinian embroidery that tells the story of each region through its unique patterns.
about.missionDescription: At Athar, we strive to highlight the beauty of Palestinian identity through heritage-inspired accessories that blend the symbolism of copper with the authenticity of Palestinian embroidery in modern designs.
about.whyDescription: Customers choose Athar's products because they offer more than just an accessory; they express identity, carry cultural value, and are presented in modern designs that combine elegance with authenticity.
